Coming soon

MealCart

From recipe to shopping list in one tap. Turn any recipe into a ready-to-shop list in seconds, grouped by aisle.

Privacy policy

The problem

Why it exists

Writing grocery lists by hand means retyping every recipe, adding up quantities in your head, and still walking the supermarket three times for the thing you forgot.

The approach

How it helps

MealCart turns any recipe into a structured shopping list automatically — paste a URL, scan a photo, or type it in. Plan a week of dinners on Sunday and MealCart merges everything into one list, deduplicates quantities, and groups items by aisle so you shop in one pass.

What’s coming

🔗Recipe importPaste any recipe URL or scan a photo to pull in the ingredients instantly.
🧾Smart shopping listQuantities merged and deduplicated across every recipe you plan.
📅Weekly meal planDrag recipes onto a weekly grid and shop for the whole week at once.
🥫Pantry trackerMark what you already own and keep it off the list automatically.
🛒Aisle groupingItems sorted by store section, so you move through the supermarket once.
⚖️Servings scalerAdjust portions and watch every quantity recalculate in real time.
🥗Macro trackingCalories, protein, carbs and fat for every planned meal.

In the works

MealCart is coming soon.
